_classes.name: nyc_school_actor_unresolved
_classes.rule: actor_raw ~ /\bprincipal\b|board of education|chancellor/i AND (agency=='Unspecified' OR (agency=='School districts' AND agency_unit is null)) AND (law_title+quote) ~ /N\.Y\. city|new york city|city of new york|population of one million|city agencies|\buft\b/i (should resolve to NYCPS)

_classes.name: assessing_unit_in_county_resolved_to_county
_classes.rule: agency=='Counties' AND actor_raw ~ /(assessing unit|municipalit\w+|school district|town|village)s? (located )?(with)?in the county of/i

_classes.name: setup_duty_shall_be_developed_deadline_none
_classes.rule: kind=='duty' AND deadline_kind=='none' AND quote ~ /shall be (developed|prepared|established|created) by/i

_classes.name: dissolution_transfer_stored_as_duty
_classes.rule: kind=='duty' AND quote ~ /shall be transferred|shall vest/i AND (law_title+quote) ~ /dissol|abolish|repeal/i; also agency_unit ~ /^(Transferred|Dissolved)\b/ (1 match)

_classes.name: widened_class_in_reprinted_sentence_missed
_classes.rule: no mechanical rule: new matter adds a person class or member (braced span inside an unbraced duty/power sentence) and no record is emitted

2013-S6935-05.note: 'Any past service costs ... shall be borne by the village of Green Island.' deadline none.

immediately; signed 2013-11-13. Only new matter is a fee exemption for voluntary ambulance services (no record, criterion 1).
immediately; new matter only adds the Carousel Center parcel to an ABC 106(13) private-party exemption list.

2011-A7259-02.note: 'Such information shall be developed by the board of education in consultation with other city agencies' - NYC board of education, stored as generic School districts; one-time setup duty with no stated deadline should be on_effective_date, stored none.

missed.note: Core duty widened by deleting '[all]' and adding '{{or guardians of potentially affected students attending the school,}}'; extends_existing true, deadline none. No stored or dropped record.

effective_date.note: Sec 1 'same date ... as chapter 426 of the laws of 2010' (2009-A5434, signed 2010-08-30, effective 'first of July next succeeding' = 2011-07-01); this act signed 2011-08-03 after that date, so 2011-07-01 stands. Rest of act immediate (2011-08-03).

Each member agency may designate an executive level officer of that agency, with responsibility for disaster preparedness matters, who may represent that agency on the commission
missed.note: New matter '{{the office for the aging,}}' adds OFA to the disaster preparedness commission, extending the existing member-agency designation power to a new member (extends_existing true). No stored or dropped record. Low confidence: membership could be read as composition only.

effective_date.note: 'sixtieth day after it shall have become a law'; signed 2012-08-01 + 60 days = 2012-09-30. Sec 2 vesting is by operation of law (no record).

2015-A5521-04.note: 'the governing body or tax department may, in its sole discretion, provide for the refund'

2009-A8956-03.note: 'the chief administrator may not eliminate the requirement of consent until after he or she shall have consulted with members of the organized bar' is a precondition of -02, not a stand-alone duty (borderline: it is a prohibition on the actor).

2009-A8956-04.note: opt-out duty, triggered by elimination, deadline none

missed.quote: by transmitting the paper to the attorney by electronic means where and in the manner authorized by the chief administrator of the courts by rule and, unless such rule shall otherwise provide, such transmission shall be upon the party's written consent
missed.note: CPLR 2103(b)(7): new matter lets the chief administrator's rule dispense with consent for electronic service; sec 4 also strikes the Sept 1 2009 expiry of this rule authority (deletion that widens). extends_existing true.

effective_date.note: 'take effect on September 1, 2009'. Proviso '180 days ... after such effective date' for paragraph (b) rules stored as section_dates rule 'unparsed' (computable: 2010-02-28); paragraph (b) sunset 2012-09-01 is section-scoped. Not a record error.
